_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note:
Twenty-seventh scheduled run. 15 of 20 URLs served a catalog -- the four marketplace and social entries have no product feed and never serve one, and Flower Meadow Dream remains refused by this environment's egress proxy, as on every day since 2026-09-16. No new matches, no cases created, nothing held, nothing cut-roses-only. Three cases stayed out of their sellers' feeds on sites that served normally: HILLSIDERO-004 for a fifth run, and Kate Roses' two for a second. No Last Verified date advanced on a listing that was not actually seen. Catalogs grew slightly almost everywhere -- Hillside 177 -> 178, Huniu 296 -> 297, Mola Rose and Muse Roses 770 -> 771, Rose Explosion 1446 -> 1447, Your Roses 1700 -> 1705 -- and none of the new products carried a chart name. Kate Roses slipped one further, 54 -> 53. 371 of 377 cases re-verified; the six unconfirmed are Flower Meadow Dream's 3, Kate Roses' 2 and HILLSIDERO-004.

Screenshots: 3 of 377 cases have one, all captured on 2026-10-19 while the evidence-card format was being built. No new cases were created today, so none were due. Capture feasibility was probed per site on 2026-10-19: 320 of 377 cases sit on sites that capture cleanly, but backfilling them has not been approved and was not run. High Garden's 46 need manual capture by the user because the seller blocks automated browsing; Hillside's 6, Flower Meadow Dream's 3 and Kate Roses' 2 are blocked by our own network policy.

AFTER THE SCHEDULED PASS (2026-10-20, out of band). The user added the www. host forms for hillsiderosefarm.com, kateroses.com, myroseworld.com and jessiesrose.com to this environment's network policy. Those four sites 301-redirect their apex to www, so only their product feeds had been reachable; their pages now are. Consequences, all recorded on the cases themselves:
  * Flower Meadow Dream served for the first time since 2026-09-16: 221 products, 4 matches with no existing case, created as MYROSEWORL-004..007 (3 Pending, 1 unstatused). The site has rebuilt its catalog as a 'fall-2026' collection.
  * Six listings are now CONFIRMED removed by HTTP 404 from the sellers' own servers, where before only feed absence was observable: MYROSEWORL-001..003 and HILLSIDERO-004, KATEROSES-001, KATEROSES-002. No Last Verified date was advanced by these checks.
  * Screenshots captured for 12 further cases; 13 of 381 cases now have one.
The delivered 2026-10-20 report predates all of this and reports Flower Meadow Dream as a coverage gap and 377 cases on record, which was accurate at 06:06. A reissue was offered to the user and not made unprompted.

sites.notes: Facebook page; facebook.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage, so the page was never reached. No open product feed exists for a Facebook page in any case.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage. The seller's own site (ergongzy.com) was crawled in full and carries the same catalog.

Crawled out of band at 09:10 MST, after the scheduled 06:06 pass. The site was unreachable at 06:06 and was reported as a coverage gap then; the user widened this environment's network policy during the morning (adding the www. host forms), and the site answered immediately. 221 products served, 4 matches without an existing case, which became MYROSEWORL-004..007. This is the first time this site has served since 2026-09-16.
sites._note: Merged into this run log after an out-of-band crawl on 2026-10-20 09:10 MST. The scheduled 06:06 pass recorded this site as a coverage gap, which is what the delivered report says; this entry supersedes it for the record.

sites.notes: Etsy shop closed (dormant). Roster entry retained per user instruction (2026-09-15); expected to stay inaccessible and not awaiting any decision.
Served normally at 178 products, up one from 2026-10-19. HILLSIDERO-004 (Catalina, unstatused) is absent for a fifth consecutive run and keeps its 2026-10-13 Last Verified date.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage.

Reached on the apex host after the www host was refused by the egress proxy. The Shopify feed returned HTTP 200 with an empty product array -- the store genuinely lists no products. Counted as checked, zero products.

Served normally at 53 products, one fewer than the 54 on 2026-10-19 and still far below the 98 it carried before the weekend contraction. Both of its cases remain out of the feed for a second run, holding their 2026-10-16 Last Verified dates. The site is healthy, so this is the seller changing what they list, not a coverage gap.

screenshot_limitation: 374 of 377 cases have no screenshot. Captures now work for 11 of the 15 sites that hold cases (320 cases); backfilling those is a scope change awaiting the user's approval. High Garden (46 cases, 7 Registered) cannot be captured automatically -- an obfuscated script on the seller's own pages detects automated browsing and blanks the page, and that access control was not bypassed. Hillside Rose Farm (6), Flower Meadow Dream (3) and Kate Roses (2) are refused by this environment's own network policy. Recorded as a coverage gap, never as a clean result.
